describe.description: The creature is a stout, quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of bare ground. It has a broad, blunt-snouted head with a large eye, a thick body with a pale creamy underbelly and a long tapering tail, and four sturdy limbs ending in clawed, five-toed feet. The dorsal surfaces of the head, back, sides, and upper tail are densely covered in overlapping dark gray-brown rounded scales, while six feathery, fringed external gills protrude from the side of the neck and the midline of the back behind the head. The overall coloration is muted gray-brown dorsally with a lighter yellowish-white throat, belly and underside of the tail.

describe.description: A stout four-legged salamander-like creature shown in side-three-quarter view facing right, with a broad flat blunt-snouted head, a pale creamy throat and belly, and a long thick tapering tail. The top of the head, back, sides and top of the tail are covered in large dark overlapping rounded scales, while the legs and underside are smooth-skinned. Behind the head are feathery external gill stalks, and the legs are thick with broad clawed toes.
